implementation: Illustrative, assumption-based case mix; not sampled or fitted from patient-level registry data and not population-representative
Normal(mean 22, SD 12), clipped to 1 to age-1 years
Age at diagnosis is clipped to age-1; 1,134 profiles therefore have duration exactly 1 year
Set equal to current HbA1c where required
If SBP >140 mmHg, probability 0.60; otherwise no
Log-normal(log mean 1.1, sigma 0.4), clipped to 0.4-6.0 mmol/L
Friedewald: total cholesterol - HDL - triglycerides/2.2; minimum 0.3
Prevalence increases with duration and HbA1c; 65% of abnormal cases microalbuminuria
<10%, 10 to <20%, and >=20%; not native treatment thresholds
Unweighted mean of finite pairwise-complete linear-weighted kappas; pairs with n<30 or identical single-category marginals are excluded
Single seed 20260613 and one prespecified generator parameter set; no repeated-seed or distribution-perturbation analysis
Python 3.12.0; NumPy 2.2.6; pandas 2.3.3; SciPy 1.16.3; Matplotlib 3.10.8; Node 22.14.0
Townsend score 0; current smoking mapped to category 2; SBP variability raw input 0; other comorbidities off
Current smoking proxies ever-smoking; sex-default height and BMI-derived weight; current HbA1c proxies mean HbA1c; SIMD quintile 3; fitted x1.32 calibration
Albuminuria mapped to ACR 10/100/500 mg/g; native 4-year risk extrapolated to 10 years under constant hazard
CHD and stroke combined using an independence approximation
Native 5-year endpoint is available in the browser but excluded from the 10-year agreement matrix
